data.title: Makkah Region’s Environment Ministry Branch Launches Festival in Thuwal to Bolster Fisheries
data.content:
Jeddah, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Makkah Region launched a festival in Thuwal yesterday as part of its broader efforts to develop the fisheries sector, promote the sustainability of marine resources, and highlight the governorate's economic and heritage assets.
    Organized to coincide with World Fisheries Day, the festival underscores the importance of protecting the marine environment and preserving fish stocks.
    Director General of the ministry's branch in Makkah Region Eng. Walid bin Ibrahim Al-Dughais said the festival serves as a significant platform to showcase Thuwal’s maritime heritage, emphasizing how the fisheries sector is an integral part of the governorate’s economic and social identity.
    -- SPA
